title: Indian-Origin British Actor Himesh Patel Steals the Spotlight in Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey
excerpt: Critics are calling the Gujarati-heritage actor's performance as Eurylochus a revelation, with some reviewers arguing he deserves co-lead billing alongside Matt Damon and Anne Hathaway.
body:
Christopher Nolan's epic adaptation of Homer's *The Odyssey* has hit theaters with a 98% Rotten Tomatoes score — and one name keeps surfacing in early reviews as the film's most pleasant surprise: Himesh Patel, the 35-year-old British-Indian actor who plays Eurylochus, Odysseus's trusted second-in-command.

<youtube>https://youtube.com/watch?v=Mzw2ttJD2qQ</youtube>

## "He Should Be Way More Centered in the Press"

Despite a cast that includes Matt Damon, Anne Hathaway, Tom Holland, Robert Pattinson, and Zendaya, critics say Patel's role in *The Odyssey* is far larger than the marketing suggested.

Critic Caroline Siede took to X to note that "Himesh Patel has more screen time than half of the actors they have out there doing photo calls and interviews. He should be way more centered in the press!" The Ringer writer Joanna Robinson agreed, asking "He's almost co-lead, honestly?" — to which Siede responded that Patel's presence is "as much as Anne [Hathaway] and Tom [Holland]."

The Associated Press called Patel's performance "excellent," while Mashable wrote that "Himesh Patel is an astounding, grounding force as Odysseus' second-in-command Eurylochus." /Film's Jeremy Mathai singled out Patel as the MVP of the entire film.

## From EastEnders to Nolan's Inner Circle

Patel's trajectory from a British soap opera to the top of Hollywood resonates deeply with the Indian diaspora experience.

Born on October 13, 1990, in Sawtry, Cambridgeshire, to Gujarati Hindu parents — his mother from Zambia, his father from Kenya — Patel grew up speaking Gujarati at home while his parents ran a newsagent's shop. He got his first acting break at 16, landing the role of Tamwar Masood on *EastEnders*, where he appeared in over 500 episodes across nine years.

His breakout global role came in Danny Boyle's 2019 musical comedy *Yesterday*, where he played a struggling musician in a world that has forgotten The Beatles. That performance opened Hollywood's doors, leading to roles in *Don't Look Up* (2021) alongside Leonardo DiCaprio and Jennifer Lawrence, and his first collaboration with Nolan in *Tenet* (2020).

Patel was also nominated for a Primetime Emmy for Outstanding Lead Actor for the HBO miniseries *Station Eleven* (2021). More recently, he played a British-Indian Dr. Watson in *Enola Holmes 3*, bringing his Indian identity into the classic literary role.

## What *The Odyssey* Means for South Asian Representation

Patel's prominent role in what is shaping up to be one of 2026's biggest blockbusters marks a significant moment for South Asian representation in Hollywood. In a film directed by perhaps the most commercially powerful filmmaker working today, an Indian-origin actor is being hailed not as a supporting player but as a co-lead whose performance anchors the entire narrative.

*The Odyssey* opened in theaters worldwide on July 17, 2026. It was shot using IMAX film cameras and is Nolan's most ambitious production to date.

*Sources: Slashfilm, Pinkvilla, Just Jared, Wikipedia*
author: Diaspora Desk
